# PCX 1.7.0

This round focuses on workflow immutability and maintainer governance.

## Highlights

- GitHub Actions pinned to immutable full-length commit SHAs.
- Explicit top-level and job-level `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions.
- Concurrency groups and timeout budgets across workflows.
- Local policy audit tooling and machine-readable approved-action inventory.
- Public-only dependency review workflow by default, plus maintainer templates for branch protection and code ownership.
